translationTable.Default: Chief Nursing Officer has issued a single binding constraint for the upcoming fiscal year: total clinical workforce spend cannot exceed 1,650,000. Within that envelope, the planning team must simultaneously decide which of 6 open hire slots to activate (at most 4), how to assign all 12 existing clinicians across Day and Night shift bands, and how to distribute a 55,000 merit pool across the workforce to maximize retention of high-value staff. These three decisions are deeply coupled — hiring a high-skill candidate consumes budget that would otherwise fund merit awards, while night-band assignments trigger a 12% differential that compounds cost across the full headcount. No single greedy strategy resolves the trade-off: activating all 6 hire slots blows the budget before merit is even considered, while a retention-only approach leaves the Day band dangerously understaffed. IBM CPLEX solves all three decisions jointly as a Mixed Integer Linear Program, returning an optimal assignment in under 0.012 seconds with $3,738 of budget slack — 99.8% utilization.
